title: 第7章 青年队的合约第8章 和队友配合的烦恼
content_zh:
第007章 青年队的合约
老伍德的办公室里，伍尔弗汉普顿的首席执行官何塞.莫克西正以审视的目光看着沙发上随意而坐的王利。
“伍德，这个小家伙就是你说的天才？你好像是一个东方人吧，是吗，小伙子？”何塞疑惑的问道。
一直听老伍德不停的提起艾伦.王这个名字，他也很想见见这个小伙子，面前的黑发小子虽然身材有些瘦弱，但何塞却从来不以表面视人的。
而且，这个小伙子能在他的目光下，这么从容的坐着，这种气质在年轻人中确实很少见，这至少说明他很自信，他现在已经对面前的黑发小子已经产生了一点兴趣。
“是的，我的父亲是一名中国人，母亲是英格兰人，我想，也许我继承父亲的血脉更多一些吧。”王利无所谓的回答道。
他可并不在乎别人的看法，在阎王的面前他都敢从容的跑掉，更别说何塞这个只经历几十年人生的老外了，面对他的目光，他根本没有任何的压力什么的。
“昨天的训练赛中，你的表现已经打动了伍尔弗汉普顿俱乐部，我们已经为你准备了一份青年队的合同，至于以后怎么样，就要靠你自己的努力了。”老伍德直截了当的说道。他可不想何塞对这个棒小伙子进行什么刁难，在他心里，先签下他，才会保险一些。
“好吧，伍德，你还真是着急，不过小伙子，我还是要提醒你，昨天你的表现虽然打动了老伍德，但是以后怎么样，还需要你自己的努力，希望你能坚持下来，想成为一名职业球员，这样还远远不够。”何塞补充道。
“我会一直努力的，而且我一定会成功的，谢谢。”王利的语气永远是这么自信，他也从来不相信自己会失败。
无论是前世带来的武功招式、内力修为方法等等都可以给他的足球技术带来极大的帮助。
而且他一直奉行一个原则，那便是做什么事情都要做好，不能中途放弃。既然已经决定了做一名足球运动员，他就要努力去做最好的球星，打败任何阻挡在他成功路上的敌人。
何塞非常满意王利的态度，一个年青人有强烈的自信，这点确实不错，尤其是一名前锋球员，有自信才能成功。
在自己的合约上签字后，王利就正式加入了伍尔弗汉普顿青年队。
老伍德心中也满是欢喜，这个小伙子终于进入了他的球队，那么之后就要为他制定一份详细的训练计划，争取最快的时间提高他的实力。
不过，以后是否能够成功，还是要靠他自己的努力了，老伍德见过太多的天才因为不努力而沦为平庸球员，他可不希望这种事情会发生在眼前这个黑发小子身上。
各种事宜办好以后，何塞就离开了办公室，他作为球队的首席执行官，可没有太多时间浪费在一名青年队的球员身上。
“艾伦，你在伍尔弗汉普顿找到住所了吗？”老伍德问道。
“还没来得及找，先生，我想一会就要去看看附近有没有适合的房子了。”王利答道，他现在也在为这个着急，如果今天找不到，那么他也只能先去旅店住了。
“不用担心，孩子，伍尔弗汉普顿有专门的球员宿舍，虽然条件有些艰苦，但年轻人就要有毅力才行。”

“哦？那实在太好了，我的东西今天晚上就能到伍尔弗汉普顿，那么我就不用为这个发愁了。”
球员宿舍一般都在俱乐部内部，即使不在俱乐部也会离它很近。能离俱乐部近一些当然好，那以后他就不用在路上浪费时间了。
至于艰苦一些，当然没有关系，王利也不是沉迷于享受的人，他知道这种人是绝对不可能成功的。
于是，他就跟着老伍德来到了球员宿舍。
现在正是午休时间，在这里居住的球员们也已经回来了。
这是一个双人间的宿舍，有两个那种下面是桌子，上面是床的摆设，里面有个白人大个子正躺在左边床上躺着看电影，并且带着耳机，嘴里还哼哼唧唧的。
“托马斯，托马斯”老伍德喊了两句，发现托马斯还在床上躺着，显然他还不知道自己的房间里多了两个人。
“托~~~~马斯！”他有些生气的大喊了一句。
床上的白人大个听了这个声音后条件反射般的跪坐了起来，只听“咚”的一声，头部便和天花板来了一次亲密接触。
这时，好像耳机的插头掉了，电脑里传来了“恩….恩…亚米碟…恩”的声音…
王利听到这个声音之后，有些汗颜，暗道日国的特产果然是广受全世界各地人民的喜爱啊。
托马斯猛然反应过来，他捂着脑袋迅速的关掉了声音，有些紧张的看了看下面的老伍德，看来他很怕这个年迈的教练。
“伍德教练，您怎么来了？”
老伍德好像有些尴尬，道：“恩，托马斯，艾伦以后就是你的室友了，你们要好好相处，那么我先走了…”说完，便转身离去，走的时候双肩还一耸一耸，显然在偷笑，又不想在两人面前表现出来，看来人越老性格就越向孩子的方向发展了。
托马斯好像是向王利表达自己的无奈般的摊了摊手，道：“你好，你是昨天球场的那个东方人吧，抱歉，我感觉东方人长相都有些相像，不好分辨。”
“没关系，我今天刚签过青年队的合同，伍德教练介绍我来这里住，那么以后咱就是室友了，我叫艾伦.王。”王利自我介绍道，他有些奇怪，昨天好像没见过这个托马斯。
“哦，我叫托马斯.维阿，是青年队的替补守门员，昨天和你一队，你表现的真不错，以后一起加油吧。”
原来如此，昨天确实没怎么注意已方的守门员，因为除了进攻，自己好像就没回过后场…
认识之后，托马斯便有些淫笑的对王利小声说道：“快来看，我昨天刚买的最新出品的DVD，那个女主角简直太漂亮了…”说着嘴里还流出了一丝口水。
“我不喜欢看这个的…真的…那我也来欣赏欣赏吧。”

不一会，宿舍里便传出了两只恶狼的淫笑声…
content_en:
Chapter 007 Youth Team Contract
In Old Wood's office, Wolverhampton CEO Jose Moxey was looking at Wang Li, who was sitting casually on the sofa, with a critical eye.
"Wood, is this little guy the genius you said? You seem to be an Oriental, right, young man?" Jose asked doubtfully.
He had been hearing Old Wood keep mentioning the name Allen Wang, and he also wanted to meet this young man. Although the black-haired boy in front of him was a little thin, Jose never looked at people based on their appearance.
Moreover, this young man can sit so calmly under his gaze. This kind of temperament is indeed rare among young people. This at least shows that he is very confident. He has now developed a little interest in the black-haired boy in front of him.
"Yes, my father is Chinese and my mother is English. I think maybe I inherit more of my father's blood." Wang Li replied nonchalantly.
He didn't care about other people's opinions. He dared to run away calmly in front of the King of Hell, let alone Jose, a foreigner who had only experienced a few decades of life. Facing his eyes, he didn't feel any pressure at all.
"Your performance in yesterday's training match has impressed Wolverhampton Club. We have prepared a youth team contract for you. As for the future, it will depend on your own efforts." Old Wood said straightforwardly. He didn't want Jose to make things difficult for this great young man. In his mind, it would be safer to sign him first.
"Okay, Wood, you are really anxious, but young man, I still want to remind you that although your performance yesterday impressed Old Wood, what happens in the future still requires your own efforts. I hope you can persevere and become a professional player. This is not enough." Jose added.
"I will keep working hard, and I will definitely succeed, thank you." Wang Li's tone is always so confident, and he never believes that he will fail.
Whether it is the martial arts moves, internal strength cultivation methods, etc. brought by his previous life, they can all bring great help to his football skills.
And he has always adhered to a principle, that is, he must do everything well and never give up halfway. Now that he has decided to be a football player, he must work hard to be the best star he can be and defeat any enemy that stands in his way to success.
Jose is very satisfied with Wang Li's attitude. It is indeed good for a young man to have strong self-confidence, especially for a forward player. Only with self-confidence can he succeed.
After signing his contract, Wang Li officially joined the Wolverhampton youth team.
Old Wood is also full of joy. This young man has finally entered his team. Then he will make a detailed training plan for him and strive to improve his strength as quickly as possible.
However, whether he can succeed in the future still depends on his own efforts. Old Wood has seen too many geniuses become mediocre players because of lack of effort. He does not want this to happen to the black-haired boy in front of him.
After all the matters were settled, Jose left the office. As the team's CEO, he didn't have much time to waste on a youth team player.
"Alan, have you found a place to live in Wolverhampton?" Old Wood asked.
"I haven't had time to look for it yet, sir. I think I'm going to see if there is a suitable house nearby." Wang Li replied. He was also worried about this now. If he couldn't find it today, he would have to stay in a hotel first.
"Don't worry, kid, Wolverhampton has a dedicated player dormitory. Although the conditions are a bit difficult, young people must have perseverance."
"Oh? That's great. My stuff will be in Wolverhampton tonight, so I don't have to worry about it."
playerThe dormitories are usually inside the club, even if they are not in the club they will be very close to it. It would be nice to be closer to the club, so he wouldn't have to waste time on the road.
As for being more difficult, of course it doesn't matter. Wang Li is not a person who is addicted to enjoyment. He knows that such a person will never succeed.
So, he followed Old Wood to the players' dormitory.
It's lunch break now, and the players who live here have also returned.
This is a double room dormitory with two desks below and beds above. There is a big white man lying on the left bed watching a movie with headphones on and humming.
"Thomas, Thomas" Old Wood shouted a few words and found Thomas still lying on the bed. Apparently he didn't know that there were two more people in his room.
"Thanks~~~Mas!" He shouted angrily.
After hearing this sound, the big white man on the bed knelt down and sat up reflexively. Hearing a "dong" sound, his head came into close contact with the ceiling.
At this time, it seemed that the plug of the earphones had fallen off, and the voice of "Well... Well... Yamidie... Well" came from the computer...
After Wang Li heard this voice, he felt a little ashamed, secretly thinking that Japan's specialties are indeed widely loved by people all over the world.
Thomas reacted suddenly. He covered his head and quickly turned off the sound. He looked nervously at Old Wood below. It seemed that he was afraid of this old coach.
"Coach Wood, why are you here?"
Old Wood seemed a little embarrassed and said: "Well, Thomas, Allen will be your roommate from now on. You two have to get along well, so I'll leave first..." After saying that, he turned and left, shrugging his shoulders as he left. He was obviously snickering and didn't want to show it in front of the two of them. It seems that the older people get, the more their personalities develop in the direction of children.
Thomas spread his hands as if to express his helplessness to Wang Li and said: "Hello, you are the Oriental at the stadium yesterday. Sorry, I feel that Orientals all look alike, so it's hard to tell them apart."
"It doesn't matter. I just signed a contract for the youth team today. Coach Wood introduced me to live here. Then we will be roommates from now on. My name is Allen Wang." Wang Li introduced himself. He was a little strange. He didn't seem to have seen this Thomas yesterday.
"Oh, my name is Thomas Weah. I am the substitute goalkeeper of the youth team. I played with you yesterday and you performed really well. Let's work together in the future."
So that’s it, I really didn’t pay much attention to my goalkeeper yesterday, because apart from attacking, I didn’t seem to be back in the backcourt...
After getting to know each other, Thomas whispered to Wang Li with a bit of a lewd smile: "Come and see, I just bought the latest DVD yesterday. The heroine is so beautiful..." There was a trace of saliva flowing from his mouth as he spoke.
"I don't like watching this...really...then I'll enjoy it too."
After a while, the lewd laughter of two evil wolves came from the dormitory...
